request: Our two coding agents keep inventing their own colours for the Fernleaf site. Turn brand/notes.md into a DESIGN.md at the project root that both of them can read.
skill_step: DESIGN.md follows Google's spec: YAML front matter with version: alpha, name, colors, typography, rounded, spacing and components whose values use {colors.x} token references, then the body sections in the canonical order Overview, Colors, Typography, Layout, Elevation & Depth, Shapes, Components, Do's and Don'ts.

checks.why: the file is where the request asked for it
it carries the brand's main green
it carries the brand's heading font
the file opens with the spec's front matter, version: alpha
colours are machine-readable tokens in the front matter, with a primary token
components reference colour tokens instead of retyping hex values
body sections follow the spec's canonical order
